title: AlphaFold DB / UniProt coverage for the DELPHI flight-and-gliding protein panel
bird_exclusion: Class Aves is this project's frozen holdout: no bird sequence or structure was fetched and no bird species is named in this panel, until the holdout exam runs.
pterosaurs: Pterosaurs are extinct and leave no DNA or protein, so no structural or sequence comparison is possible for them anywhere in this layer.
method: Per (species, protein): UniProtKB search for each candidate gene symbol restricted to the taxon, one record picked by (reviewed, exact gene-symbol match, length); then the AlphaFold DB prediction API for that accession. "absent" distinguishes no-UniProt-entry from UniProt-entry-but-no-AlphaFold-model. Family-level taxa (Exocoetidae, Hemiramphidae, Belonidae) are searched across the whole taxonomic subtree.

flying fish (Exocoetidae).note: family-level probe; the convergent lat4a F326L lineage

gliding halfbeak (Hemiramphidae).note: family-level probe; Daane 2021's second enlarged-fin lineage

medaka (Oryzias latipes).note: PROXY for Exocoetidae: same order Beloniformes, has a reference proteome

zebrafish (Danio rerio).note: the species every intervention in genotype/ was done in

fruit fly (Drosophila melanogaster).note: insect flight; orthology to vertebrate genes is distant or absent

kcnk5b.label: Kcnk5b / KCNK5 (K2P potassium channel)
kcnk5b.assembly: domain-swapped DIMER (2 subunits, each with 2 pore domains)
kcnk5b.note: zebrafish alf alleles are dominant gain of function in this channel

kcnh2a.label: Kcnh2a / KCNH2 (hERG-family channel)
kcnh2a.note: the longfin lof allele is cis-regulatory, not coding

gja1b.label: Gja1b / Cx43 (gap-junction alpha-1)
gja1b.assembly: HEXAMER (one connexon); a full channel is two connexons docked = 12 subunits
gja1b.note: insects have innexins, not connexins; absence in Drosophila is real, not an annotation gap

slc43a2a.label: Slc43a2a / Lat4a / SLC43A2 (L-type amino-acid transporter 4)
slc43a2a.assembly: monomer or homodimer; not established in our sources
slc43a2a.note: carries the flying-fish convergent F326L and the zebrafish nr21 T200K

hhip.label: Hhip / HHIP (Hedgehog-interacting protein)
hhip.note: hhip loss is our only sourced route to a LARGER pectoral fin

shha.label: Shha / SHH (Sonic hedgehog)
shha.assembly: monomer; signalling N-terminal domain binds Hhip, Ptch1, Cdo/Boc

tbx5a.label: Tbx5a / TBX5 (T-box transcription factor)
tbx5a.assembly: monomer on DNA; T-box DNA-binding domain

prdm1a.label: Prdm1a / PRDM1 (PR/SET + zinc-finger transcription factor)
prdm1a.note: m805 premature stop in the SET domain
